basic_details.post_name: Medical Officer - AYUSH (MHT) (Male), Medical Officer - AYUSH (MHT) (Female), Pharmacist and 1 more
basic_details.short_information: District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Jhargram (DH&FWS Jhargram), West Bengal, has invited applications for 33 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. DH&FWS/JGM/2026/1899. The posts include Medical Officer - AYUSH (MHT) (Male), Medical Officer - AYUSH (MHT) (Female), Pharmacist, Staff Nurse. The online application is open from 31 October 2026 to 19 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: online. Last date to pay the fee: 18 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Diploma, GNM, depending on the post

Pay: 32,000 per month. Qualification required: Two years Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharma) (Allopathic) from an institute approved by Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)/AICTE; Registration Certificate must be issued by West Bengal Pharmacy Council. Age limit: Minimum 18 years but not exceeding 40 years. Pay: 22,000 per month. Qualification required: Completed GNM training course from an institute recognised by Indian Nursing Council; Registration Certificate must be issued by West Bengal Nursing Council. Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Pay: 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DH&FWS Jhargram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 19 November 2026. Applications opened on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DH&FWS Jhargram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 33 vacancies: 8 Medical Officer - AYUSH (MHT) (Male), 11 Medical Officer - AYUSH (MHT) (Female), 12 Pharmacist, 2 Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DH&FWS Jhargram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General: Rs. 100. Reserved category: Rs. 50.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Medical Officer - AYUSH (MHT) (Male): maximum 40 years; Medical Officer - AYUSH (MHT) (Female): maximum 40 years; Pharmacist: minimum 18 years but not exceeding 40 years; Staff Nurse: maximum 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 32,000 per month for Medical Officer - AYUSH (MHT) (Male), 32,000 per month for Medical Officer - AYUSH (MHT) (Female), 22,000 per month for Pharmacist, 25,000 per month for Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Diploma, GNM, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate should be a permanent resident of West Bengal and able to read, write and speak Bengali. All experience should be counted after the completion of requisite qualification.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academic qualification proportionate marking. Experience marks where applicable. Document verification. Academic marks based on 10th, 12th, professional degree and post-graduation/experience.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on contractual basis under National Health Mission (NHM).
